Offline & music links

For your phone, download the PDF and save it in Files or Downloads. The HTML is self-contained too, but some phone file viewers limit interactive controls. Test your copy in airplane mode. A downloaded file does not update itself; reopen the live guide and save a fresh copy.

Song titles use verified Spotify app deep links. Web links provide a browser fallback. Download songs inside Spotify beforehand. App link resolution can still require connectivity, and audio is not embedded in this guide.

Save stars stay in the current browser if local storage is available; they are not backed up across devices.

Source notes & latest changes
  • Added the newly released official Spirit Lake programming: 35 music sets and 28 activities, including House of the Lost and Incendia.
  • Overview stage headers now stay visible, align during sideways scrolling, and release at the table bottom.
  • Phone scrolling improved: normal page scroll, full-width stage/camp picker, previous/next buttons and optional all-stage overview.
  • Redesigned as expanded official-style daily stage grids with campground lanes.
  • Added separate non-musical schedule: seven confirmed start times plus five untimed experiences.
  • Official Spirit Lake activities timetable still awaits publication.
  • First edition: 90 official slots and 39 campground entries, including Wednesday pre-parties.
  • Wooksville posted set times included. Camp Wubble date/time conflicts remain TBA; no time was inferred.
  • Camp Reddit full festival timetable was not published in the sources checked. Big Win × Sentere Wednesday pre-party included.
  • Song links use verified Spotify track IDs. Unmatched artists remain without sample links.

Official stages follow the published Hulaween schedule. Campground sets follow their linked announcements. Different silent disco headphone channels get separate lanes. Dashed boxes mark a start time with an unknown end: their height is a label, not an inferred duration. Unconfirmed dates/times stay in the TBA sections.
